title: Paul McCartney live: Adopt-A-Minefield Gala, Los Angeles | 2004
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the fourth annual Adopt-A-Minefield Gala at the Century Plaza Hotel in Los Angeles, California, USA, on 15 October 2004.

McCartney performed at the charity’s gala event each year from 2001 to 2005. This year’s set included a duet with Neil Young on the latter’s 1970 song ‘Only Love Can Break Your Heart’.

Concert setlist

  • ‘Drive My Car’
  • ‘Till There Was You’
  • ‘In Spite Of All The Danger’
  • ‘Blackbird’
  • ‘Here Today’
  • ‘Follow Me’
  • ‘Only Love Can Break Your Heart’
  • ‘Michelle’
  • ‘Yesterday’
  • ‘Get Back’
  • ‘Let It Be’
  • ‘Lady Madonna’
  • ‘Baby Face’
  • ‘Hey Jude’

Adopt-A-Minefield Gala appearances

  • 14 June 2001: Beverly Wilshire, Los Angeles, USA
  • 18 September 2002: Century Plaza Hotel, Los Angeles, USA
  • 23 September 2003: Beverly Hilton, Los Angeles, USA
  • 15 October 2004: Century Plaza Hotel, Los Angeles, USA
  • 15 November 2005: Beverly Hilton, Los Angeles, USA
